text:
alex: Putting a hard stop on the US-canary (8%) for /v1/generate. Noticing a sudden uptick in token counts and HTML escape growth after today's tokenizer tweak. Halting at once and requesting a pin to the previous stable. @deploy-bot please pin us-east-2 to redwood-gen-3.9.7 and drop canary to 0%. Change window listed until 23:59 PT.

deploy-bot: <deploy-bot> pin request received. executing...
```bash
POST /rollouts/pin 
{
  "model": "redwood-gen-3.9.7",
  "region": "us-east-2",
  "reason": "token inflation + HTML escape regression",
  "requested_by": "alex"
}
```
-> ack id=roll-9982

nina: How large is the cost impact? Any sign it's only a small client or systemic?
alex: Early numbers: median tokens/request up ~18% on a subset; tail cost looks worse. Logs point to a client sending large HTML payloads right when change landed. Could be a crawler or batch job.
quentin: Good call to stop. @nina can infra run a quick filter: count requests with content_type header = text/html and model like '%3.10%' in the last 10m? If it's one caller we can reach out to them before a full rollback.
nina: running quick query: `SELECT caller_id, count(*) FROM requests WHERE region='us-east-2' AND content_type='text/html' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' GROUP BY caller_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5;` -> top caller = helper-service-7 (612 requests). Baseline for that caller ~4/min.
deploy-bot: Pin applied: roll-9982 -> redwood-gen-3.9.7 pinned in us-east-2 until 2026-03-24T06:00:00Z. Canary 8% -> 0%. pin_status: success.
quentin: Let's run a focused eval: compare embeddings/similarity on our html-heavy evalset and compute per-1000-token cost delta. alex: I'll kick eval and start a short QA pass. Plan: 45m pin; if metrics normalize we can resume at 3% then ramp. If regression persists, rollback fully and open release postmortem.
nina: Creating an ops ticket and paging infra on-call. ops-bot: TKT-20260324-04 created, owner=alex.
alex: Drafting a customer-facing blurb for release notes: "Temporary revert of tokenizer tweak due to HTML payload tokenization inflation; investigating root cause; customers may see slight latency/cost variance during verification." Will DM PMs.
quentin: Also add a line in release notes about the canary metrics: tokens/request delta and embed quality delta. We need that for the exec update.
alex: ACK. Will post results here in ~12m.
